description: This file implements functionality for managing Wi-Fi signal strength thresholds, including retrieving signal data via system commands, handling threading for periodic checks, and exposing methods to enable or disable threshold change notifications. It defines a class 'WifiManagerSignalThreshold' with associated methods and internal functions.

classes.name: WifiManagerSignalThreshold
classes.description: Class responsible for managing Wi-Fi signal threshold monitoring and notifications.

methods.name: stopSignalThresholdThread
methods.description: Stops the signal threshold monitoring thread.

methods.name: setSignalThresholdChangeEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables signal threshold change notifications, with optional interval.

methods.name: isSignalThresholdChangeEnabled
methods.description: Checks if signal threshold change notifications are enabled.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Main loop that periodically checks Wi-Fi signal strength and triggers notifications if changed.

methods.name: startThread
methods.description: Starts the monitoring thread with specified interval.
